name: bloomer
headline: crm for florists with customer insights
short_description: Grow your business. Bloom with confidence: Bloomer is a comprehensive, all-in-one CRM platform specifically designed for flower shops and florists. It provides tools for customer management, marketing automation, and business analytics to help flower shops thrive in the modern marketplace.
author: ryanmello

sections.overview:
Bloomer is a specialized Customer Relationship Management platform designed specifically for flower shops and florists. It addresses the unique operational needs of floral businesses by combining customer management, occasion tracking (birthdays, anniversaries), email marketing automation, inventory management with shelf-life monitoring, and seamless Square POS integration. The platform helps small to medium-sized flower shops streamline order processing, manage perishable inventory, run targeted seasonal campaigns, and make data-driven business decisions through real-time analytics. Built with modern web technologies including Next.js and MongoDB, Bloomer provides an intuitive interface with audience segmentation, coupon management, and automated marketing workflows—filling a gap left by generic, costly CRM solutions.
Track customer occasions (birthdays, anniversaries) and send automated reminder campaigns
Manage perishable inventory with expiration date monitoring and low-stock alerts
Segment customers into groups (VIP, New, Repeat, Potential) for targeted email marketing
Sync customer and order data from Square POS system for unified business operations
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ryanmello/bloomer`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a marketing consultant for [FLOWER_SHOP_NAME], a flower shop in the [CITY] area. Using the Bloomer CRM platform, create a 30-day marketing plan to increase foot traffic and online orders. Include strategies for social media, email marketing, and local promotions. Focus on [TARGET_AUDIENCE], such as brides, corporate clients, or local residents.
```
Copy

```
# 30-Day Marketing Plan for [FLOWER_SHOP_NAME]
```
